applicable margin for Pounds Sterling.label: Payments for Legal Settlements

weighted average interest rates on short.label: Short-term Debt

Amortization of actuarial (gain) loss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

Interest expense, net.label: Investment Income, Interest

Other non-operating deductions, net.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Other non-operating deductions, net.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

Total non-operating deductions, net.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
Total non-operating deductions, net.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

Total non-operating deductions, net.label: Operating Income (Loss)

interest costs incurred.label: Recapitalization Costs

Interest cost.label: Cost of Revenue

Interest cost.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
Interest cost.description: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

Recognized net actuarial (gain) loss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

Net Leverage Ratio.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

Total actuarial losses recognized in Acc.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)

Total liabilities.label: Liabilities
Total liabilities.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Total liabilities.label: Liabilities, Current
Total liabilities.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

Property, plant and equipment, net.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Property, plant and equipment, net.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

Long-term debt.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

provision for credit loss.label: Payments for Rent
provision for credit loss.description: Cash payments to lessor's for use of assets under operating leases.

provision for credit loss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
provision for credit loss.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

Segment Assets.label: Assets
Segment Assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Segment Assets.label: Assets, Current
Segment Assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Outstanding balance.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
Outstanding balance.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

Shares outstanding.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
Shares outstanding.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Consolidated income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
Consolidated income from operations.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

Consolidated income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
Consolidated income from operations.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

Net income.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
Net income.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

Net income.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
Net income.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.

Diluted earnings per share.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
Diluted earnings per share.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

Diluted earnings per share.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
Diluted earnings per share.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

Net sales.label: Inventory, Net
Net sales.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

Net sales.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Net sales.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

Marketing and administrative expenses.label: Costs and Expenses
Marketing and administrative expenses.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

Marketing and administrative expenses.label: General and Administrative Expense
Marketing and administrative expenses.description: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

Marketing and administrative expenses.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
Marketing and administrative expenses.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

Research and development expenses.label: Research and Development Expense
Research and development expenses.description: The aggregate costs incurred (1) in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service, a new process or technique, or in bringing about a significant improvement to an existing product or process; or (2) to translate research findings or other knowledge into a plan or design for a new product or process or for a significant improvement to an existing product or process whether intended for sale or the entity's use, during the reporting period charged to research and development projects, including the costs of developing computer software up to the point in time of achieving technological feasibility, and costs allocated in accounting for a business combination to in-process projects deemed to have no alternative future use.

Research and development expenses.label: Deferred Tax Assets, in Process Research and Development
Research and development expenses.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from in-process research and development costs expensed in connection with a business combination.

Research and development expenses.label: Costs and Expenses

Income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
Income from operations.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

Operating margin %.label: Operating Income (Loss)

Provision for taxes on income.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
Provision for taxes on income.description: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

Provision for taxes on income.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
Provision for taxes on income.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

Effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Effective tax rate.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent

Effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent

Total tax provision.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

U.S. statutory rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
U.S. statutory rate.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

U.S. statutory rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
U.S. statutory rate.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

Consolidated effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
Consolidated effective tax rate.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

Consolidated effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
Consolidated effective tax rate.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

Consolidated effective tax rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
Consolidated effective tax rate.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

Depreciation and depletion expense.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
Depreciation and depletion expense.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

Depreciation and depletion expense.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
Depreciation and depletion expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

Net gain on sale of assets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
Net gain on sale of assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.
Net gain on sale of assets.metric_type: Net gain on sale of assets

Net gain on sale of assets.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
Net gain on sale of assets.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
Net gain on sale of assets.metric_type: Net gain on sale of assets

Amortization expense.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
Amortization expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

Amortization expense.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
Amortization expense.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

Estimated amortization expense.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
Estimated amortization expense.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

Estimated amortization expense.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
Estimated amortization expense.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

Bad debt expense.label: Advertising Expense
Bad debt expense.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

Bad debt expense.label: Interest Expense
Bad debt expense.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense.

Service cost.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
Service cost.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

Expected return on plan assets.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
Expected return on plan assets.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

Expected return on plan assets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
Expected return on plan assets.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

Segment income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
Segment income from operations.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

Segment income from operations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
Segment income from operations.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

Gain on sale of assets, net.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
Gain on sale of assets, net.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.
Gain on sale of assets, net.metric_type: Gain on sale of assets, net

Gain on sale of assets, net.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
Gain on sale of assets, net.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
Gain on sale of assets, net.metric_type: Gain on sale of assets, net

Net Sales.label: Inventory, Net
Net Sales.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

Net Sales.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Net Sales.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

Capital Expenditures.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
Capital Expenditures.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

Capital Expenditures.label: Additional Paid in Capital
Capital Expenditures.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.

Consolidated net sales.label: Inventory, Net
Consolidated net sales.description: Amount after valuation and LIFO reserves of inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

Consolidated net sales.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Consolidated net sales.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

Environmental & Infrastructure.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies
Environmental & Infrastructure.description: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

Environmental & Infrastructure.label: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Current
Environmental & Infrastructure.description: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable in twelve months or in the next operating cycle if longer.

Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Cash, cash equivalents and short-term in.metric_type: Cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments

Cash and cash equivalents.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
Cash and cash equivalents.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalents restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

Net cash used in investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash used in investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.
Net cash used in investing activities.metric_type: Net cash used in investing activities

Net cash provided by (used in) financing.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.metric_type: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities

Net cash provided by (used in) financing.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.
Net cash provided by (used in) financing.metric_type: Net cash provided by (used in) financing activities

Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currencies; including, but not limited to, disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.
Effect of exchange rate changes on cash.metric_type: Effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalents

Allowance for doubtful accounts.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
Allowance for doubtful accounts.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

Allowance for doubtful accounts.label: Accounts Payable, Current
Allowance for doubtful accounts.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

Cash paid for amounts included in the me.label: Additional Paid in Capital
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.metric_type: Cash paid for amounts included in the measurement of lease liabilities

Cash paid for amounts included in the me.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.
Cash paid for amounts included in the me.metric_type: Cash paid for amounts included in the measurement of lease liabilities

Restructuring liability, end of period.label: Restructuring Costs
Restructuring liability, end of period.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

Restructuring liability, end of period.label: Restructuring Charges
Restructuring liability, end of period.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period to foreign, federal, state, and local authorities as taxes on income, net of any cash received during the current period as refunds for the overpayment of taxes.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Net cash paid for income taxes.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Net cash paid for income taxes.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.
Net cash paid for income taxes.metric_type: Net cash paid for income taxes

Total inventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories
Total inventories.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

Total assets.label: Assets
Total assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Total assets.label: Assets, Current
Total assets.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are expected to be realized in cash, sold, or consumed within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events.

Ending balance at December 31, 2023.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2023.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Ending balance at December 31, 2024.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
Ending balance at December 31, 2024.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

Cash dividends.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
Cash dividends.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

Cash dividends.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Cash dividends.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

Cumulative foreign currency translation.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
Cumulative foreign currency translation.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

Cumulative foreign currency translation.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax
Cumulative foreign currency translation.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.metric_type: Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net of tax expense (benefit) of $ 0.1 in 2024 and $( 1.2 ) in 2023 )

Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.
Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net.metric_type: Unrealized gain on cash flow hedges (net of tax expense (benefit) of $ 0.1 in 2024 and $( 1.2 ) in 2023 )

Debt extinguishment expenses.label: Costs and Expenses
Debt extinguishment expenses.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

Loans outstanding under the Revolving Fa.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
Loans outstanding under the Revolving Fa.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.
Loans outstanding under the Revolving Fa.metric_type: Loans outstanding under the Revolving Facility

Base rate.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
Base rate.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

Amortization rate of Term Loan Facility.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
Amortization rate of Term Loan Facility.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.
Amortization rate of Term Loan Facility.metric_type: Amortization rate of Term Loan Facility

Original issue discount.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
Original issue discount.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

Outstanding balance.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
Outstanding balance.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

Outstanding balance.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
Outstanding balance.description: Indicate number of shares or other units outstanding of each of registrant's classes of capital or common stock or other ownership interests, if and as stated on cover of related periodic report. Where multiple classes or units exist define each class/interest by adding class of stock items such as Common Class A [Member], Common Class B [Member] or Partnership Interest [Member] onto the Instrument [Domain] of the Entity Listings, Instrument.

Current maturities of long-term debt.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
Current maturities of long-term debt.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

Common stock.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
Common stock.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

Common stock.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
Common stock.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

Common stock.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
Common stock.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

Additional paid-in capital.label: Additional Paid in Capital
Additional paid-in capital.description: Excess of issue price over par or stated value of the entity's capital stock and amounts received from other transactions involving the entity's stock or stockholders. Includes adjustments to additional paid in capital. Some examples of such adjustments include recording the issuance of debt with a beneficial conversion feature and certain tax consequences of equity instruments awarded to employees. Use this element for the aggregate amount of additional paid-in capital associated with common and preferred stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only common stock, use the element additional paid in capital, common stock. For additional paid-in capital associated with only preferred stock, use the element additional paid in capital, preferred stock.

Accumulated other comprehensive loss.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
Accumulated other comprehensive loss.description: Accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, net of tax effect, at period end. Excludes Net Income (Loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Includes foreign currency translation items, certain pension adjustments, unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities, other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses related to factors other than credit losses on available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities that an entity does not intend to sell and it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis, as well as changes in the fair value of derivatives related to the effective portion of a designated cash flow hedge.

Common stock held in treasury, at cost.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.metric_type: Common stock held in treasury, at cost

Common stock held in treasury, at cost.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.metric_type: Common stock held in treasury, at cost

Common stock held in treasury, at cost.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.
Common stock held in treasury, at cost.metric_type: Common stock held in treasury, at cost

Purchases of property, plant and equipme.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.metric_type: Purchases of property, plant and equipment

Purchases of property, plant and equipme.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
Purchases of property, plant and equipme.metric_type: Purchases of property, plant and equipment

Other investing activities.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
Other investing activities.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

Other investing activities.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
Other investing activities.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

Debt issuance costs.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
Debt issuance costs.description: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

Repayment of long-term debt.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt
Repayment of long-term debt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

Repayment of short-term debt.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt
Repayment of short-term debt.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

Purchase of common stock for treasury.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
Purchase of common stock for treasury.description: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.
Purchase of common stock for treasury.metric_type: Purchase of common stock for treasury

Purchase of common stock for treasury.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
Purchase of common stock for treasury.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.
Purchase of common stock for treasury.metric_type: Purchase of common stock for treasury

Tax withholding payments for stock-based.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
Tax withholding payments for stock-based.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.
Tax withholding payments for stock-based.metric_type: Tax withholding payments for stock-based compensation

Tax withholding payments for stock-based.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
Tax withholding payments for stock-based.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.
Tax withholding payments for stock-based.metric_type: Tax withholding payments for stock-based compensation

Dividends paid to non-controlling intere.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Dividends paid to non-controlling intere.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

Cash dividends paid.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
Cash dividends paid.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

Cash dividends paid.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
Cash dividends paid.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

Property, plant and equipment additions.label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
Property, plant and equipment additions.description: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.
Property, plant and equipment additions.metric_type: Property, plant and equipment additions related to asset retirement obligations

Property, plant and equipment additions.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
Property, plant and equipment additions.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.
Property, plant and equipment additions.metric_type: Property, plant and equipment additions related to asset retirement obligations

Treasury stock purchases settled after p.label: Treasury Stock, Value
Treasury stock purchases settled after p.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.
Treasury stock purchases settled after p.metric_type: Treasury stock purchases settled after period end

Excise tax charged to equity not paid.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.metric_type: Excise tax charged to equity not paid

Excise tax charged to equity not paid.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
Excise tax charged to equity not paid.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity.
